scoring_justification: Full recompute from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox. The strongest feasible tier is structural: we verify the trend of coverage-independent average binding energy (max difference ≤0.02 eV) and numeric closeness to paper gold within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for binding energies, distances, charge transfer and tolerances
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Adsorption mechanism of water molecules on the surface of ZnO-SAW sensors' (DOI:10.1016/j.chemphys.2020.110915) Section 3.2
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's reported numeric results (binding energies, O-Zn distance, H-O distance, charge transfer). The average binding energy for four water molecules is 0.1475 eV (paper text); total for 10 water molecules is 1.473 eV and average 0.1473 eV (paper text). Total for 4 water molecules is derived as 4*0.1475=0.59 eV, consistent with paper claims of unchanged average binding energy.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual reported values from the paper, used as reference for the reproduction task. No synthetic data fabrication; they match the reference solve.sh output.

outputs.description: Computed DFT adsorption properties: total and average binding energies for 1, 4, 10 water molecules, and for the single-water case O-Zn distance, H-O distance, and charge transfer.

output_contract.notes: The agent must use an open-source DFT code with PBE functional; small systematic shifts from the reference are absorbed by tolerances. The checker compares reported values to hidden paper-reported gold with appropriate tolerances and also checks coverage independence of average binding energy.
